architecture.problem: The reach-local map hides its authored capture ribbon, but the remaining live material was a non-transmitting detail overlay forced to 0.88-0.98 coverage. That produced a pale opaque sheet without the Single Layer Water volume the material assumed beneath it.
architecture.retained_solution: A second non-colliding solver-conforming mesh supplies Single Layer Water optical depth only through quads whose four vertices are wet and whose minimum station/bank coverage is at least 0.60. It sits 1 cm beneath the live detail surface and reuses the raft-floor transmission aperture.
architecture.pilot_scope: Chilko only. Existing versioned Lava Canyon maps migrate from their unique cooked-field identity; future regeneration persists bEnableLiveSolverVolumeCore.

visual_comparison.interpretation: The retained capture changes the water body from warm chalk-gray to blue-gray, restores readable optical depth and reflections, and preserves a curved wet-bank intersection. Highlight clipping remains broadly unchanged and still requires an art-lighting pass.
